metadata.title: Explicit cohomological transfer for Morita equivalent Lie groupoids
metadata.abstract: It is well known that Morita equivalent Lie groupoids have isomorphic differentiable cohomology. At the cochain level, however, explicitly transporting a cocycle from one groupoid to a Morita equivalent one is less straightforward. We provide explicit formulas for such cohomological transfers in arbitrary degree. More precisely, for the pullback of a Lie groupoid along a surjective submersion, we construct an explicit cochain-level homotopy inverse to the natural pullback map. We first treat Čech groupoids, where the construction only involves a partition of unity, and then extend it to arbitrary surjective submersions, for which the extra choice of local sections is needed. We also show that the resulting operators preserve the complexes associated with $\mathcal{VB}$-groupoids, including homogeneous and $\mathcal{VB}$-cochains. As an application, we obtain explicit transfer maps for deformation cocycles of Morita equivalent Lie groupoids and recover the Morita invariance of deformation cohomology.
